rules.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named primeFibInner source-level while statement from its exact MPY constructors.
Macro expansion defining the named primeFibInnerCore proof term as the corresponding internal #while loop head.
Macro expansion defining the named primeFibOuter source-level Fibonacci-search while statement.
Macro expansion defining the named primeFibOuterCore proof term as the corresponding internal #while loop head.
Macro expansion defining primeFibBody as the exact initialization, outer loop, and return constructor sequence.
Base equation of the primeScan summary: when the next divisor exceeds the square-root bound, the incoming flag is the scan result.
Divisor case of the primeScan recurrence: a divisor within the scan bound defines the result to be false.
Non-divisor recurrence equation for primeScan, oriented as a fold from the next divisor state to the current named summary.
Additional false-flag absorption fact used for simplification; prove.sh never first proves this exact rule in a module that omits it.
Base equation of primeFibSearch: once the accumulated count reaches the target, the current Fibonacci value A is the result.
Additional one-step exit-boundary simplifier deriving result B when the next prime-bit update reaches the target; its exact statement is not separately proved without this rule.
Inductive recurrence equation for primeFibSearch, oriented to fold the updated count and Fibonacci state back to the current summary.
